mentions.name: Smart Dealer Poker Button
mentions.description: An IoT networked, time-synced smart dealer button for poker games. It replaces the traditional plastic dealer button passed from dealer to dealer with a connected IoT display that informs players of the current blind level and other tournament information. Provisional patents have been filed; a holding page for the project (current placeholder name "NUTS") is at buttonsqueeze.com.
mentions.problem: The plastic dealer button passed around in poker games does not inform players what level the blinds are or other tournament details.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on an IoT networked, time sync'd "Smart Dealer Poker Button" - replacing the plastic thing that gets passed around from the current dealer to the next dealer with a IoT display that informs players what level the blinds are etc etc.
